people.name: Julius
people.line: A centurion of the Augustan Cohort

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly, and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.
translations.bsb: The next day we landed at Sidon, and Julius treated Paul with consideration, allowing him to visit his friends and receive their care.
translations.kjv: And the next day we touched at Sidon. And Julius courteously entreated Paul, and gave him liberty to go unto his friends to refresh himself.
translations.asv: And the next day we touched at Sidon: and Julius treated Paul kindly, and gave him leave to go unto his friends and refresh himself.
